Main functions

List SAS files in a directory

Use a targets pipeline template for converting SAS registers to Parquet

Functions used within the targets pipeline

These functions are not expected to be used outside the targets pipeline created with the template.

Get register name from a group of file paths
split_paths_by_register()
Group file paths by register name
